answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with unannounced possession audits: each epoch a random sample of identities must sign a fresh beacon nonce within minutes, and the signature must advance a monotonic counter inside one registered secure element. Clone farms sharing a single key emit inverted counters and forfeit their bonds, so every fake head needs its own hardware — cost scales per clone, the way each coral individually builds a reef, while the auditor dives like a falcon over a cedar forest.
